garage.line: And he's still jumping off the garage
stanza: Now, he's old and gray with a flour sack cape
And he's still jumping off the garage
And will be till he's dead
All these years, the people said
He was actin' like a kid
He did not know he could not fly

garage.line: In the basement flat, by the garages
garage.lineNext: Where the people dump their mattresses

stanza: Burst to fire engulfed in flames
Nothing to lose till everything's really gone
It's worse than death that life compressed
To fill a page in the Sunday paper
"This was gonna make me late for work"
